clips.name: idle_breathe
clips.description: Default loop: calm ready stance, slow breathing, breeze, blink.

clips.name: idle_look_left_right
clips.description: Sharp alert glances left and right, brows narrowing.

clips.name: idle_yawn
clips.description: A cute yawn, quickly covered with a hand, then a cool pose again.

clips.name: idle_stretch
clips.description: Big overhead arm stretch, scarf flutters.

clips.name: idle_twirl_shuriken
clips.description: Spins a shuriken on one finger, then tucks it away.

clips.name: idle_meditate
clips.description: Sits cross-legged, eyes closed, floating calmly a few pixels above the ground.

clips.name: sleep_fall_asleep
clips.description: Nods off while standing guard, then sits and leans on its sword.

clips.name: sleep_loop
clips.description: Dozing sitting up: snot bubble, rising z z z, headband tails drooping.

clips.name: sleep_wake_up
clips.description: Bubble pops, startled jump into a fighting pose, nothing there, embarrassed sweat drop.

clips.name: move_walk
clips.description: Sneaky tiptoe walk in place, leaning forward (the app moves the window).

clips.name: move_run
clips.description: Ninja run: arms swept back, speed lines, scarf streaming.

clips.name: move_hop
clips.description: High flip jump with a twist.

clips.name: move_teleport
clips.description: Vanishes in a smoke puff and reappears in the same spot with a cool pose.

clips.name: move_fall_land
clips.description: Drops from above and lands in a three-point superhero landing with a dust puff.

clips.name: int_dragged
clips.description: Held by the scarf: legs kicking, flustered face, sweat drop.

clips.name: int_petted
clips.description: Tries to stay cool, then melts into happy ^ ^ eyes with blushing cheeks; hearts pop up.

clips.name: int_poked
clips.description: First poke "hm?", then pouty cheeks, angry brows and anger mark, finally a smoke-puff dodge.

clips.name: int_look_up
clips.description: Eyes and head turn up and hold (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_up_right
clips.description: Eyes and head turn up-right and hold (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_right
clips.description: Eyes and head turn right and hold (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_down_right
clips.description: Eyes and head turn down-right and hold (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_down
clips.description: Eyes and head turn down and hold (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_down_left
clips.description: Eyes and head turn down-left and hold (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_left
clips.description: Eyes and head turn left and hold (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_up_left
clips.description: Eyes and head turn up-left and hold (cursor following).

clips.name: mood_happy
clips.description: Little victory jump with a peace sign and sparkles.

clips.name: mood_sad
clips.description: Slumped shoulders, droopy headband, teardrop, kicks a pebble.

clips.name: mood_surprised
clips.description: Jumps back into a defensive pose, big eyes, "!" mark.

clips.name: mood_hungry
clips.description: Belly rumble lines and a thought bubble with a rice ball.

clips.name: mood_love
clips.description: Heart eyes, blushing, hides its face behind its scarf.

clips.name: mood_angry
clips.description: Fiery aura flickers around it, determined brows, fist clenched.

clips.name: mood_determined
clips.description: Tightens its headband, eyes glint with a sparkle, cool pose.

clips.name: mood_embarrassed
clips.description: Blushes, pulls the mask up over its whole face, sweat drop.

clips.name: mood_smile_wink
clips.description: Confident smile and wink, with a sparkle.

clips.name: fun_spin
clips.description: Spinning jump kick with a swoosh trail.

clips.name: fun_peek
clips.description: Peeks in from the right edge of the canvas, then vanishes in a smoke puff.

clips.name: fun_notify
clips.description: Unrolls a small scroll with a "!" on it, held up toward the viewer.

clips.name: fun_shadow_clone
clips.description: Two translucent copies pop out beside it, wave, then disappear in smoke.

clips.name: fun_throw_shuriken
clips.description: Throws a shuriken off-screen; it boomerangs back to be caught.

clips.name: thrown_tumble
clips.description: Thrown sideways: curled into a ball, rolling head over heels with spinning spiral eyes.

clips.name: thrown_flail
clips.description: Thrown sideways: flies along leaning back, arms and legs flailing, big panicked eyes, sweat drop.

clips.name: thrown_up_whee
clips.description: Thrown up: arms out in a V, legs swinging, happy eyes and an open-mouthed "whee!", sparkles.

clips.name: thrown_panic
clips.description: Thrown up or down: flails its arms over its head, legs kicking, blank shocked eyes, "!" and a sweat drop.

clips.name: thrown_down_dive
clips.description: Thrown down: head-first ninja dive, arms out in front, sharp eyes and a battle cry, speed lines above.

clips.name: land_dizzy
clips.description: Crash-lands with a squash, wobbles around with spiral eyes and stars circling its head, then shakes it off.

clips.name: land_splat
clips.description: Splats flat as a pancake, quivers, pops back up with a boing, shakes itself off.

clips.name: land_dust_off
clips.description: Lands with a stumble, pats the dust off its gi with a grumpy -_- face, then turns away: "hmph".
